| [126](#morphoexitbook-126) | Rejects a service fee sitting exactly on the documented cap.<br>Caught by: [`rcMeSetServiceFeeAtCapIsReachable`](../../specs/MorphoExitBook_LinkedCore/MorphoExitBook_LinkedCore_properties.spec#L872) |
| [127](#morphoexitbook-127) | Skips the fee write whenever the configured new fee is exactly zero.<br>Caught by: [`rcMeSetServiceFeeDisableIsReachable`](../../specs/MorphoExitBook_LinkedCore/MorphoExitBook_LinkedCore_properties.spec#L883) |

| [141](#morphoexitbook-141) | Resolves a request's market via its neighbor's binding instead of its own.<br>Caught by: [`rvMeFillExitRequestRevertsOnZeroBacking`](../../specs/MorphoExitBook_LinkedCore/MorphoExitBook_LinkedCore_properties.spec#L1468) · [`hlMeFillTouchesOnlyItsOwnMarket`](../../specs/MorphoExitBook_LinkedCore/MorphoExitBook_LinkedCore_properties.spec#L397) |

| [2651](#morphoexitbook-2651) | Scales the ramp's climb by the whole time since the request was placed instead of by the time since the ramp opened.<br>Caught by: [`utMeRampRateInterpolatesLinearly`](../../specs/MorphoExitBook_LinkedCore/MorphoExitBook_LinkedCore_properties.spec#L511) |

| [2653](#morphoexitbook-2653) | Charges the receiver the protocol's service-fee rate instead of the rate the request's own priority ramp quotes.<br>Caught by: [`utMeFillPaysReceiverFillLessPriorityFee`](../../specs/MorphoExitBook_LinkedCore/MorphoExitBook_LinkedCore_properties.spec#L541) |

| [3005](#morphoexitbook-3005) | Withdraws a fill from the book's own supply position instead of the lender's, so a fill burns the book's own shares.<br>Caught by: [`utMeFillLeavesTheBookWithoutACorePosition`](../../specs/MorphoExitBook_LinkedCore/MorphoExitBook_LinkedCore_properties.spec#L598) |
| [3301](#morphoexitbook-3301) | Prices a fill against the request market oracle before withdrawing.<br>Caught by: [`ooMeFillNeverReadsTheOracle`](../../specs/MorphoExitBook_LinkedCore/MorphoExitBook_LinkedCore_oracle_outage.spec#L19) |
